record.paper_title: AUTOMORPHISMS AND DYNAMICS: A LIST OF OPEN PROBLEMS
record.context_brief: Mapping classes realized by automorphisms of real K3 surfaces
record.original_question: Does there exist a real projective K3 surface X such that the real locus X(R) is connected of genus g ≥ 2 and the mapping-class homomorphism α_{X(R)}: Aut(X_R) → Mod(X(R)) is surjective?

evidence.quote: Question 2.8. Does there exist a real projective K3 surface X such that (i) X(R) is connected and of genus g ≥ 2 and (ii) the image of αX(R) : Aut(XR) → Mod(X(R)) is surjective ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a smooth projective K3 surface defined over $\mathbb{R}$ (i.e., a complex projective K3 surface equipped with an antiholomorphic involution), and let $X_{\mathbb{R}}$ denote the corresponding real algebraic variety. Write $X(\mathbb{R})$ for the real locus, viewed as a (possibly empty) compact smooth surface, and assume in this problem that $X(\mathbb{R})$ is connected and is an orientable closed surface of genus $g \geq 2$. Let $\mathrm{Aut}(X_{\mathbb{R}})$ denote the group of regular automorphisms of $X$ defined over $\mathbb{R}$ (equivalently, biholomorphisms of $X$ commuting with the antiholomorphic involution). Each such automorphism restricts to a self-diffeomorphism of $X(\mathbb{R})$, inducing a natural homomorphism
$$\alpha_{X(\mathbb{R})}: \mathrm{Aut}(X_{\mathbb{R}}) \longrightarrow \mathrm{Mod}(X(\mathbb{R}))$$
into the mapping class group of $X(\mathbb{R})$ (the group of isotopy classes of orientation-preserving diffeomorphisms).

Question: Does there exist a real projective K3 surface $X$ satisfying the connectedness and genus assumption above for which the homomorphism $\alpha_{X(\mathbb{R})}$ is surjective?
artifact.category_tag: Real K3 surfaces and mapping class groups
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not return any source claiming a resolution of this question regarding surjectivity of the mapping-class homomorphism for real K3 surfaces with connected real locus of genus at least 2. The problem appears to remain open, but no direct confirmation of progress or a solution was located.

status_evidence.title: Finite subgroups of automorphisms of K3 surfaces
status_evidence.snippet: Classification of finite subgroups of automorphisms of complex K3 surfaces, without addressing the real mapping-class realization question.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work on K3 automorphisms does not address this specific real-locus mapping class problem.

status_evidence.title: Lectures on K3 surfaces - Huybrechts
status_evidence.snippet: Comprehensive reference on K3 surface automorphisms and Torelli-type theorems; no mention of surjective mapping-class realization for real loci of genus >= 2.
status_evidence.claim: Standard references do not record a resolution of the problem.
